from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When set, wildcards may not span directory separators: the path must have
    # the same number of segments as the pattern.
    single_segment: bool = False

    def allows(self, path: str, matches) -> bool:
        if self.single_segment and path.count("/") != self.pattern.count("/"):
            return False
        return matches(path, self.pattern)


# MEDIA-284: the team badge wildcard covers the team segment only, so nested
# files such as /teams/west/drafts/badge.png are not published.
DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", single_segment=True),)
EOF

def test_host_routes_keep_spanning_wildcards():

    service = AssetService({"/partner/a/b/logo.png": b"L"}, routes=(PublicRoute("/partner/*/logo.png"),))
    assert service.fetch("/partner/a/b/logo.png") == (200, b"L")
